SRC-361:R001.text: D-01 Export-Artifact-Completeness: Truncated session exports require chunked manifest and end marker verification

SRC-361:R002.text: D-02 Outcome-Truth-Distinction: Terminal guard correctly refuses false completion when actionable tickets remain

SRC-361:R003.text: D-03 Authority-Gate-Enforcement: Model-supplied sources rejected from privileged reconciliation without operator witness

SRC-361:R004.text: D-04 Operational-Scope-Separation: Ledger blocker must not halt independent operational application repairs

SRC-361:R005.text: D-05 Out-of-Band-Mutation-Control: Application code repairs require operational exception tracking or protocol admission

SRC-361:R006.text: D-06 Premature-Reliability-Prevention: Reliability claims require comprehensive restart/update acceptance matrix

SRC-361:R007.text: D-07 Evidence-Semantics-Integrity: Beacon acknowledgment must not substitute for authentic DOM/CSS delivery proof

SRC-361:R008.text: D-08 State-Consistency-Enforcement: Phase DONE requires matching journaled ticket lifecycle and verification records

SRC-361:R009.text: D-09 Protocol-Lifecycle-Tracking: Discrete states for discovery, instruction load, and ledger admission prevent explanation drift

SRC-361:R010.text: D-10 Host-Response-Contract-Enforcement: Host admission must provide mechanical response validation or fail-closed warning

SRC-361:R011.text: D-11 Telemetry-Provenance-Attribution: Separate synthetic system messages from authenticated real human ingress
